# Phase 3.25 — Design traceability

Exact mappings come from design/DESIGN-INDEX.json and Phase 1 coverage. DESIGN_VERIFIED means an exact source reference maps to the ticket; it is not rendered parity or approval of new product behavior. DESIGN_PARTIAL means only shared references exist. DESIGN_GAP means the exact surface is absent. Missing images are never fabricated.
